baselineWorkflow.description: GitHub pull request and branch protection plus CI tests and model evaluations, manual approval, deployment records, and rollback records.

assignmentPolicy.blinding: Evaluator receives arm-neutral cost and outcome records where operationally possible.

successPaths.rule: Fewer escaped regressions at no greater median active review effort, with no increase beyond the frozen false-block tolerance.
At least 20 percent lower median reconstruction cost with non-inferior escaped-regression and false-block rates.

claimBoundary: This manifest is a protocol template, not evidence that an adopter, operator, evaluator, repository, or pilot result exists.
